summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-client 2.1.3 drops Bun runtime in preinstall and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file `math_init.js` bundled inside the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte Bun-CJS bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) that is heavily obfuscated: a rotated string-array shifter (`WV8StW`) over a large numeric/string array, single-letter and hex-mangled identifiers, and no readable code. The advertised purpose of the package is a React chatbot UI plus an NSwag-generated axios API client, which has no need for a second language runtime at install nor for an opaque bundle unrelated to those advertised components. Fetching Bun at install and using it to execute an obfuscated payload bypasses Node-oriented tooling and gives arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine at `npm install` time. The `@servicetitan` scope is used to lend publisher trust to the dropper; the legitimate React/NSwag source coexists with the unrelated obfuscated install-time payload, consistent with a compromised or squatted maintainer account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
